text: Which box hosts the staging server, and on which port? One line, no thinking.

summary:
**Summary**

Ana walked AllIn through 40 numbered points, asking for a proposal and justification for each. Points 17–40 repeat points 1–16 verbatim (17–23 = 1–7; 24–39 = 8–16; 40 = 8). AllIn answered each with the same structure: a proposal, one main reason, two rejected alternatives (status quo; a 3+ week rewrite that would block other work), a decision statement, and the same open item — ana to assign ownership at the Thursday meeting and record it in project notes. Revisiting is only before the next release, never mid-release.

The 16 unique decisions:

1. Staging server: port 9940 on box **lince** (only box with 64 GB).
2. Database: **PostgreSQL 17**, one schema per client (row-level security too slow).
3. Login flow: **magic links**, 15-min expiry (clients forget passwords).
4. Error logging: **JSON lines**, daily rotation, 30-day retention (old syslog lost stack traces).
5. Release calendar: release **every second Thursday** (Mondays clash with support).
6. Backups: nightly to NAS **tejón**, weekly offsite (last restore took 6 h).
7. API versioning: **/v2** prefix; v1 frozen until March (two clients still on v1).
8. Mobile app: **PWA** this year, no native app (budget 40 000 €).
9. Search box: **PostgreSQL full-text search** first (Elasticsearch needs another box).
10. Invoices: **PDF via WeasyPrint**, numbered per year (accountant's request).
11. Support inbox: **one shared inbox with tags**, no ticket tool (only two answerers).
12. Load testing: **k6, 500 virtual users** before each release (March outage hit at 300).
13. Translations: **Spanish + Catalan** now, English later (most clients in Girona).
14. Design system: **plain CSS variables**, no framework (old Bootstrap theme caused conflicts).
15. Monitoring: **Uptime Kuma**, 1-min ping (last outage discovered by phone).
16. Access rights: **three roles** — owner, editor, reader (a fourth existed but was never used).

Open for ana: assign an owner to each of the 16 items at the Thursday meeting and write the assignments into the project notes. No other questions are pending.
